data.value:
SELECT Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, (CASE WHEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) > 0 THEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningDebit, (CASE WHEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningCredit, SUM(Debit) AS Debit, SUM(Credit) AS Credit, (CASE WHEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) > 0 THEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) ELSE 0 END) AS ClosingDebit, (CASE WHEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) < 0 THEN ABS((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) ELSE 0 END) AS ClosingCredit, Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag FROM ( SELECT GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, 0 AS Debit, 0 AS Credit FROM GL_CodeCombinationDetail WHERE --GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID IN ({CompanyIDs}) AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID IN ({ChartOfAccountIDs}) AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningDebit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningCredit, 0 As Debit, 0 As Credit FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID IN ({CompanyIDs}) AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID IN ({ChartOfAccountIDs}) AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID IN ({PeriodIDs}) AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
UNION ALL
SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Debit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Credit FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID IN ({CompanyIDs}) AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID IN ({ChartOfAccountIDs}) AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID IN ({PeriodIDs}) AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate ) Tab_COA_Tran1 INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON --Tab_COA_Tran1.CompanyID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID AND Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID AND Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID INNER JOIN SET_AccountType ON SET_AccountType.AccountTypeID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID WHERE GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1 GROUP BY Tab_COA_Tran1.CompanyID, Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag

data.name: Query_GetAuditTrailReport
data.value:
Select Distinct CompanyID, PeriodID, TransactionID, DocumentTypeID, DocumentType, DocumentNo, DocumentDate, ControlCredit, ControlDebit, ApprovedBy, ApprovedByValue, DateOfApproval, Narration, TransactionHeaderStatus, CreateDate, UpdateDate, CreatedBy, CreatedByValue, UpdatedBy, UpdatedByValue, SerialNo, CodeCombinationID, AccountDescription, DocumentReference, CostCenterID, CostCenterName, CurrencyID, CurrencyName, ConversionRate, AmountFC, Amount, TransactionType, TransactionDetailStatus, BaseCurrencyID, BaseCurrencyName, MultiCurrency, IsUpdateVoucher, IsMismatchTotal, (CASE WHEN MultiCurrency = 1 AND DifferenceConversionAmount <> 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END) AS IsDifferenceConversionAmount, (CASE WHEN LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(DefaultAccountCode))) > 0 AND TotalDocTypeAccountCode = 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END) AS IsDefaultAccountCodeNotUsed From ( Select GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID, GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GL_TransactionHeader.ControlCredit, GL_TransactionHeader.ControlDebit, GL_TransactionHeader.ApprovedBy, aspnet_Users_2.UserName AS ApprovedByValue, GL_TransactionHeader.DateOfApproval, GL_TransactionHeader.Narration, GL_TransactionHeader.Status AS TransactionHeaderStatus, GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate, GL_TransactionHeader.UpdateDate, GL_TransactionHeader.CreatedBy, aspnet_Users.UserName AS CreatedByValue, GL_TransactionHeader.UpdatedBy, aspnet_Users_1.UserName AS UpdatedByValue, GL_TransactionDetail.SerialNo, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description As AccountDescription, GL_TransactionDetail.DocumentReference, GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, GL_TransactionDetail.CurrencyID, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, GL_TransactionDetail.ConversionRate, GL_TransactionDetail.AmountFC, GL_TransactionDetail.Amount, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, GL_TransactionDetail.Status AS TransactionDetailStatus, ( Select (SUM(ConversionRate * AmountFC) - SUM(Amount)) From GL_TransactionDetail WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID ) AS DifferenceConversionAmount, SET_OperatingUnit.BaseCurrencyID, SET_Currency_1.CurrencyName AS BaseCurrencyName, SET_OperatingUnit.MultiCurrency, ISNULL(GL_TransactionHeader.DefaultAccountCode, '') AS DefaultAccountCode, ( Select Count(GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID) From GL_TransactionDetail WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = GL_TransactionHeader.DefaultChartofAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionHeader.DefaultAccountCode AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionHeader.DefaultTransactionType ) AS TotalDocTypeAccountCode, (Case WHEN GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate <> GL_TransactionHeader.UpdateDate THEN '1' Else '0' END) AS IsUpdateVoucher, (Case WHEN GL_TransactionHeader.ControlDebit <> GL_TransactionHeader.ControlCredit THEN '1' Else '0' END) AS IsMismatchTotal From GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {2} INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON --GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID LEFT OUTER JOIN SET_CostCenter ON GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID = SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_Company.CompanyID INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit ON (SET_Company.OperatingUnitId = SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId) INNER JOIN SET_Currency ON (GL_TransactionDetail.CurrencyID = SET_Currency.CurrencyID) INNER JOIN SET_Currency SET_Currency_1 ON (SET_OperatingUnit.BaseCurrencyID = SET_Currency_1.CurrencyID) INNER JOIN aspnet_Users ON (GL_TransactionHeader.CreatedBy = aspnet_Users.UserId) LEFT JOIN aspnet_Users aspnet_Users_1 ON (GL_TransactionHeader.UpdatedBy = aspnet_Users_1.UserId) LEFT OUTER JOIN aspnet_Users aspnet_Users_2 ON (GL_TransactionHeader.ApprovedBy = aspnet_Users_2.UserId) WHERE (GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1) AND (GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1) AND (GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID) AND (GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID) -- AND ((GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID) OR (@DocumentTypeID = -1)) AND (((GL_TransactionHeader.CreatedBy = @UserID) OR (@UserID IS NULL)) OR ((GL_TransactionHeader.UpdatedBy = @UserID) OR (@UserID IS NULL))) AND ((GL_TransactionHeader.ApprovedBy = @ApprovedBy) OR (@ApprovedBy IS NULL)) {0} {1}
--AND --( -- ((CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), [GL_TransactionHeader].[DocumentDate], 110) AS DATETIME) >= @DateFrom) OR (@DateFrom IS ----NULL)) AND --((CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), [GL_TransactionHeader].[DocumentDate], 110) AS DATETIME) <= @DateTo) OR (@DateTo IS NULL)) --OR --((CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), [GL_TransactionHeader].[UpdateDate], 110) AS DATETIME) = @DateFrom) OR (@DateFrom IS NULL)) --AND --((CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), [GL_TransactionHeader].[UpdateDate], 110) AS DATETIME) = @DateTo) OR (@DateTo IS NULL)) -- ) ) Tab_AuditTrail ORDER BY DocumentDate, DocumentTypeID, DocumentNo, SerialNo;

data.name: Query_GetBalanceSheetReportForDashboard

Select description,C.CodeCombinationID,OpeningDebit,OpeningCredit from ( Select Derivetable.CodeCombinationID as CodeCombinationID,SUM(OpeningDebit) as OpeningDebit,sum(OpeningCredit) as OpeningCredit from ( SELECT substring(Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID,1,@ChartOfAccountSEG) as CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, (CASE WHEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) > 0 THEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningDebit, (CASE WHEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningCredit, SUM(Debit) AS Debit, SUM(Credit) AS Credit, (CASE WHEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) > 0 THEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) ELSE 0 END) AS ClosingDebit, (CASE WHEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) < 0 THEN ABS((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) ELSE 0 END) AS ClosingCredit, Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag FROM ( SELECT GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, 0 AS Debit, 0 AS Credit FROM GL_CodeCombinationDetail WHERE --GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartOfAccountID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1
UNION ALL SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningDebit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningCredit, 0 As Debit, 0 As Credit FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartOfAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
UNION ALL SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Debit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Credit FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartOfAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate >= @FromDate AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate ) Tab_COA_Tran1 INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON --Tab_COA_Tran1.CompanyID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID AND Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID AND Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID INNER JOIN SET_AccountType ON SET_AccountType.AccountTypeID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID AND SET_AccountType.AccountTypeID in (1, 2, 3) WHERE GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1 GROUP BY Tab_COA_Tran1.CompanyID, Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag )DeriveTable group by DeriveTable.CodeCombinationID ) DeriveTable2 inner join (Select distinct description,codecombinationid from GL_CodeCombinationDetail) C on DeriveTable2.CodeCombinationID=C.CodeCombinationID

data.name: Query_GETProfitAndLossReportForDashboard
data.value:
Select description,C.CodeCombinationID,OpeningDebit,OpeningCredit from ( Select Derivetable.CodeCombinationID as CodeCombinationID,SUM(OpeningDebit) as OpeningDebit,sum(OpeningCredit) as OpeningCredit from ( SELECT substring(Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID,1,@ChartOfAccountSEG) as CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, (CASE WHEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) > 0 THEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningDebit, (CASE WHEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningCredit, SUM(Debit) AS Debit, SUM(Credit) AS Credit, (CASE WHEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) > 0 THEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) ELSE 0 END) AS ClosingDebit, (CASE WHEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) < 0 THEN ABS((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) ELSE 0 END) AS ClosingCredit, Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag FROM ( SELECT GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, 0 AS Debit, 0 AS Credit FROM GL_CodeCombinationDetail WHERE --GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartOfAccountID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1
UNION ALL SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningDebit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningCredit, 0 As Debit, 0 As Credit FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartOfAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
UNION ALL SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Debit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Credit FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartOfAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate >= @FromDate AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate ) Tab_COA_Tran1 INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON --Tab_COA_Tran1.CompanyID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID AND Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID AND Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID INNER JOIN SET_AccountType ON SET_AccountType.AccountTypeID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID AND SET_AccountType.AccountTypeID in (4, 5) WHERE GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1 GROUP BY Tab_COA_Tran1.CompanyID, Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag ) DeriveTable group by DeriveTable.CodeCombinationID ) DeriveTable2 inner join (Select distinct description,codecombinationid from GL_CodeCombinationDetail) C on DeriveTable2.CodeCombinationID=C.CodeCombinationID

data.name: Query_GetTrialBalanceReportForDashBoard
data.value:
Select description,C.CodeCombinationID,OpeningDebit,OpeningCredit from ( Select Derivetable.CodeCombinationID as CodeCombinationID,SUM(OpeningDebit) as OpeningDebit,sum(OpeningCredit) as OpeningCredit from ( SELECT substring(Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID,1,@ChartOfAccountSEG) as CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, (CASE WHEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) > 0 THEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningDebit, (CASE WHEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningCredit, SUM(Debit) AS Debit, SUM(Credit) AS Credit, (CASE WHEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) > 0 THEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) ELSE 0 END) AS ClosingDebit, (CASE WHEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) < 0 THEN ABS((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) ELSE 0 END) AS ClosingCredit, Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag FROM ( SELECT GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, 0 AS Debit, 0 AS Credit FROM GL_CodeCombinationDetail WHERE --GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartOfAccountID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1
UNION ALL SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningDebit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningCredit, 0 As Debit, 0 As Credit FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartOfAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
UNION ALL SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Debit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Credit FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartOfAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate >= @FromDate AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate ) Tab_COA_Tran1 INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON --Tab_COA_Tran1.CompanyID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID AND Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID AND Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID WHERE GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1 AND (GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag = @DetailPostingAllowedFlag OR @DetailPostingAllowedFlag IS NULL) GROUP BY Tab_COA_Tran1.CompanyID, Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, substring(Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID,1,@ChartOfAccountSEG), GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag ) DeriveTable group by DeriveTable.CodeCombinationID ) DeriveTable2 inner join (Select distinct description,codecombinationid from GL_CodeCombinationDetail) C on DeriveTable2.CodeCombinationID=C.CodeCombinationID

data.name: Query_Select_By_TransactionID_ChartOfAccId_CompanyId
data.value: SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.SerialNo, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID, GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, isnull(SET_Department.DepartmentID, -1) DepartmentID, SET_Department.DepartmentName, GL_TransactionDetail.Narration, isnull(GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID, -1) CostCenterID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, GL_TransactionDetail.CurrencyID, Set_Currency.CurrencyName, isnull(GL_TransactionDetail.ConversionRate, GL_TransactionDetail.AmountFC) Rate, GL_TransactionDetail.DocumentReference, GL_TransactionDetail.AmountFC, --ISNULL(AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Amount, GL_TransactionDetail.AmountFC) AS Amount, GL_TransactionDetail.Amount AS Amount, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, GL_TransactionDetail.IncurredOnID, INV_Item.Description as IncurredName, '' Action FROM GL_TransactionDetail inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID = GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID --And GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID inner join Set_Currency on Set_Currency.CurrencyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CurrencyID left join SET_Department on SET_Department.DepartmentID = GL_TransactionDetail.DepartmentID left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID Left Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = GL_TransactionDetail.IncurredOnID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID where GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = @TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = @Status order by GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType Desc

data.value: SELECT Cane_Grower.GrowerName, Cane_Grower.GrowerCode, GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID, GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID, GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, SET_Company.OperatingUnitId, SET_OperatingUnit.BaseCurrencyID, SET_Currency_1.CurrencyName AS BaseCurrencyName, SET_Currency_1.CurrencySign AS BaseCurrencySign, GL_TransactionHeader.ControlCredit, GL_TransactionHeader.ControlDebit, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_TransactionDetail.CurrencyID, SET_Currency.CurrencyName, GL_TransactionDetail.Amount AS Debit, GL_TransactionDetail.Amount AS Credit, GL_TransactionDetail.AmountFC, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, GL_TransactionDetail.DocumentReference, GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, GL_TransactionDetail.IncurredOnID, (Select Case GL_TransactionDetail.IncurredOnID when null then '' else (select Description from INV_Item where ItemID = IncurredOnID) end) as ItemDescription, Set_Department.DepartmentID, Set_Department.DepartmentName, GL_TransactionDetail.ConversionRate, GL_TransactionHeader.Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.Narration as TransactionDetailNarration, GL_TransactionHeader.ApprovedBy, aspnet_Users.UserName, GL_TransactionHeader.DateOfApproval, GL_TransactionHeader.CreatedByValue As UpdatedByValue, SET_OperatingUnit.MultiCurrency, SET_DocumentType.[Description] as DocumentDescription, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountName, AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchName, AP_PaymentHeader.BankAccountID, AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerBankBranchID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName FROM GL_TransactionHeader left JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 left JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 --and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.companyid = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID LEFT OUTER JOIN SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CurrencyID AND SET_Currency.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_Company ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_Company.CompanyId AND SET_Company.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_Company.OperatingUnitId = SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId and SET_Company.BusinessId = SET_OperatingUnit.BusinessId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SET_Currency SET_Currency_1 ON SET_OperatingUnit.BaseCurrencyID = SET_Currency_1.CurrencyID AND SET_Currency.Status = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID AND SET_CostCenter.Status = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN Set_Department ON Set_Department.DepartmentID = GL_TransactionDetail.DepartmentID AND Set_Department.Status = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN aspnet_Users ON aspnet_Users.UserId = GL_TransactionHeader.ApprovedBy LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID left JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerId left join AR_SET_BankAccount on AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BankAccountID inner join Cane_Loan on Cane_Loan.LoanHeaderID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo and Cane_Loan.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID and Cane_Loan.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID inner join Cane_Grower on Cane_Grower.GrowerID = Cane_Loan.CustomerID and Cane_Grower.CompanyID = Cane_Loan.CompanyID and Cane_Grower.PeriodID = Cane_Loan.PeriodID LEFT join AR_SET_BankBranch on AR_SET_BankBranch.BankBranchID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerBankBranchID Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.companyid = @companyid and SET_DocumentType.periodid = @periodid

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED select
(select max(financialid)+1 from set_financialheader) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.NAME ASC) as FinancialID , t.NAME FinancialName, convert(bit,0) NewPage, 'D' as ElementType, 'L' as Alignment, convert(bit,0) Bold , --ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description ASC) as ElementSequence , @FinancialHeaderID as ElementSequence, t.NAME ElementName, '' as NoteNo, convert(bit,0) ExpectedResultInDb, convert(bit,0) DataIn, convert(bit,1) FixedInput, convert(decimal, t.Amount)as Amount, convert(bit,0) DataToBeCollected, null as Formula, '000' FinancialCode, 0 as Segment, @fromcode as COACodeFrom , @tocode as COACodeTo, '' AS Action, 2 as OrderBy from ( select finaltab.name,sum(finaltab.Amount)Amount from ( select 'Opening' AS DocumentType, @ToDate AS CreateDate, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.Name, -1 AS SourceID, SUM(TABopening.Amount) as Amount, '' AS InstrumentNo, '' Comments, '' AS InvoiceNumbers, '' AS InvoiceDocumentNo, '' AS DocumentNo, @ToDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 AS ForAlhajAmount , TABopening.StatusCode from ( SELECT FINTAB.DocumentType, Fintab.CreateDate, FINTAB.CustomerID, FINTAB.Name, FinTab.SourceID, SUM(FINTAB.Amount) as Amount, FINTAB.InstrumentNo, FINTAB.Comments, FINTAB.InvoiceNumbers, FINTAB.InvoiceDocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentDate, FINTAB.FreightAmount, FINTAB.ForAlhajAmount , FINTAB.StatusCode FROM ( Select 'Opening' as DocumentType, @ToDate AS CreateDate, openingTAB.CustomerID, openingTAB.Name, -1 AS SourceID, sum(openingTAB.Amount) as Amount, '' as InstrumentNo, '' as Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, '' as DocumentNo, @ToDate as DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount , openingTAB.StatusCode From ( ---------- OPENING BALANCE VENDOR INVOICE ---------- SELECT 0 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS Name, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID as SourceID ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode between @fromcode and @tocode INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode LEFT Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate And SET_DocumentType.status = 1
GROUP BY AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode ) OpeningTAB GROUP BY OpeningTAB.CustomerID ,OpeningTAB.Name,OpeningTAB.StatusCode
UNION ALL
select distinct TABInvoice.DocumentType, TABInvoice.CreateDate, TABInvoice.CustomerID, TABInvoice.BusinessPartnerName, TABInvoice.SourceID, TABInvoice.Amount, TABInvoice.InstrumentNo, TABInvoice.Comments, TABInvoice.InvoiceNumbers, TABInvoice.InvoiceDocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentDate, TABInvoice.FreightAmount, TABInvoice.ForAlhajAmount ,TABInvoice.StatusCode from (
SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.companyID, Set_DocumentType.TransactionType, case when AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode is null then ( select top 1 CUS.TypeCode from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = CUS.TypeCode And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1
) else AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode end as TypeCode, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) else ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) end as CustomerID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) else ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceHeader.Status= 1 And CUS.Status= 1 ) end as BusinessPartnerName, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID as SourceID, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then (Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) else ( Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid else (AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid+AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount - isnull(AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount,0)) * -1 end ) end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.Description AS Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode between @fromcode and @tocode LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
--and SET_DocumentType.documenttype not like '%Opening%' ) TABInvoice where TABInvoice.companyID in @CompanyID AND TABInvoice.TypeCode in (@TypeCode)
UNION ALL ---------- Payment ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID And childPayment.Status = 1 ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And Payment.Status = 1 ), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID And AP_PaymentDetail.Status = 1 ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 --AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode between @fromcode and @tocode INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (@TypeCode)
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode UNION ALL
-- PAYMENT -- SINGLE BUSINESS PARTNER CASE SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID And childPayment.Status = 1 ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 0, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID and payment.status = 1
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID And AP_PaymentDetail.status = 1 ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And payment1.Status = 1 ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 --AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate And SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (@TypeCode)
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID,AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments ,AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode UNION ALL -----------Sale Invoice Header----------- select TAB.DocumentType,TAB.CreateDate,CustomerID,BusinessPartnerName,SourceID,sum(Amount) as Amount,InstrumentNo,Comments,InvoiceNumbers,InvoiceDocumentNo,DocumentNo,DocumentDate,FreightAmount,ForAlhajAmount,StatusCode from ( SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as SourceID, case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Credit Note' then SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * -1 else
case when isnull((select FieldValue1 from Set_Parameter where FieldName = 'SROPercent'),0) != 0 then ( case isnull(AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName,'') when 'S.R.O' then (case isnull(Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.FurtherTax,0) when 0 then ((Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.Amount * (Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.GST + Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.FurtherTax)/100 )* isnull((select FieldValue1 from Set_Parameter where FieldName = 'SROPercent'),0) / 100) else 0 end) when 'Customer' then ( case isnull(FurtherTax,0) when 0 then SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid - ((Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.Amount * (GST + FurtherTax)/100 ) * isnull((select FieldValue1 from Set_Parameter where FieldName = 'SROPercent'),0) / 100) else SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid end ) else 0 end ) else SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid end end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.description AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount * -1, 0) else ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount, 0) end as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount,SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 left join Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail on Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.status = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (@TypeCode)
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Customer' LEFT JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightCode AND GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate AND SET_DocumentType.Status= 1
GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount,SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode ,GL_TransactionDetail.Amount
,Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.Amount,Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.GST,Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.FurtherTax ,AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName,SAL_InvoiceHeader.description ) as TAB group by TAB.DocumentType,TAB.CreateDate,CustomerID,BusinessPartnerName,SourceID,InstrumentNo,Comments,InvoiceNumbers,InvoiceDocumentNo,DocumentNo,DocumentDate,FreightAmount,ForAlhajAmount,StatusCode
union all --RECEIPT TRANSACTION SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID as SourceID, case when (select DocumentType from Set_documentTYpe where Set_documentTYpe.status= 1 And Set_documentTYpe.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID) like 'Receipt Against Sale%' then (select sum(Amount) from AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail where AR_ReceiptInvoicesDetail.status = 1 And ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID) *-1 else AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount * -1 end as Amount, max(AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.InstrumentNo) AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND
