SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID as SourceID, Case when AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount else AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount * -1 end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Narration Else ' ' + AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount , AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode between @fromcode and @tocode
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode
AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (@TypeCode) INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode LEFT Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode
INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @FromDate and @Todate -- AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @Todate and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' AND SET_DocumentType.Status= 1
GROUP BY AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, Comments, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Narration
UNION ALL -- Commission On Receipt SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID as SourceID, ((AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount * AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CommissionPercentage)/100) * -1 as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Narration Else ' ' + AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.EmployeeID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (@TypeCode) INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode Left Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Status = 1 and AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.codecombinationid between @fromcode and @tocode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate -- AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.Status= 1
GROUP BY AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CommissionPercentage, AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID, AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptAccountID,AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Amount, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, Comments, ReversalComments ,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode ,AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Narration -------- SALE DISCOUNT -----------
union All SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.DiscountTransactionHeaderID as SourceID, (SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.CalculatedAmount * -1) as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.DiscountTransactionHeaderID, 0) AS DocumentNo, SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.RunDateTime AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,1 as statuscode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.Status= 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode
AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (@TypeCode) INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AND SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.RunDateTime BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate -- AND SAL_DiscountTransactionHeader.RunDateTime <= @ToDate And SET_DocumentType.Status= 1
union all
------------------------------------- KNON of Advance SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, GL_TransactionDetail.SerialNo as SourceID, (GL_TransactionDetail.Amount) as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID And dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.Status= 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode
AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID In (SELECT Distinct DefaultAccountCode FROM dbo.SET_DocumentType WHERE (DocumentType Like 'Advance Against PO%') And status= 1 AND (CompanyID in @CompanyID) AND (PeriodID = @PeriodID))) AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit')
LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode between @fromcode and @tocode LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode
AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (@TypeCode) LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @ToDate
union all
------------------------------------- KNON of Advance cOPY OF 2 SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, GL_TransactionDetail.SerialNo + 1 as SourceID, (GL_TransactionDetail.Amount * -1) as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount ,AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID And dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.Status= 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode
AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID In (SELECT Distinct DefaultAccountCode FROM dbo.SET_DocumentType WHERE (DocumentType Like 'Advance Against PO%') And Status= 1 AND (CompanyID in @CompanyID) AND (PeriodID = @PeriodID))) AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit')
LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status = 1 and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode between @fromcode and @tocode LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode
AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (@TypeCode) LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate -- AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @ToDate
--union all -- -----------Sale Invoice Header----------- New Opening -- SELECT 'Opening' as DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, -- AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, -- SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as SourceID, -- case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Credit Note' then SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * -1 else -- SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid end as Amount, -- '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, -- ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, -- CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount * -1, 0) else ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount, 0) -- end as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount,SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode -- FROM SET_DocumentType -- INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType -- And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status= 1 -- INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID -- AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 -- AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
-- INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID -- and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode
-- INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
-- LEFT JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightCode -- AND GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID -- AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID -- AND GL_TransactionDetail.status= 1
-- and GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID between @fromcode and @tocode
-- WHERE AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate -- and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' -- GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, -- SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode
) AS FINTAB GROUP BY DocumentType, CreateDate, CustomerID, NAME, SourceID, InstrumentNo, Comments, InvoiceNumbers, InvoiceDocumentNo, DocumentNo, DocumentDate, FreightAmount, ForAlhajAmount , StatusCode ) as TAb -- For Transation type Filter
) as FinalTAB
where FinalTAB.Amount <> 0 and FinalTAB.StatusCode = 1 group by finaltab.name )t where t.Amount<>0

data.name: Query_StoreMovementSummary
data.value:
select Description,CodeCombinationID,sum(ThroughStore)as ThroughStore,sum(PriceDifferential)as PriceDifferential,sum(Adjustment)as Adjustment, GroupID from (
Select tab.CodeDescription as Description ,CodeCombinationID,sum(Amount) as ThroughStore , 0 as PriceDifferential, 0 as Adjustment , tab.GroupID
from ( Select GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,
INV_Item.ItemID,std.TransactionQuantity * (-1) AS TransactionQuantity, std.TransactionCost, INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, ((std.TransactionQuantity * (-1)) * std.TransactionCost) Amount, sth.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, case when std.JobID > 0 then Set_Job.AccountCode else Inv_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID end as ExpenseAccountCCID , sth.DocumentNo,std.JobCode, std.JobID , SET_ItemCatalog.GroupID
From INV_StockTransactionHeader sth INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail std ON std.StockTransactionID = sth.StockTransactionID AND std.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND std.FiscalID = sth.FiscalID AND std.Status = 1 Inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].menuID in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx','/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx')) and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1
left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GIN on GIN.StockTransactionID = std.SourceHeaderID and GIN.DocumentTypeID = std.SourceDocumentTypeID and GIN.CompanyID = std.CompanyID and GIN.PeriodID = std.PeriodID and GIN.FiscalID= std.FiscalID
Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID =std.JobID and Set_Job.CompanyID = std.CompanyID
INNER JOIN INV_ITem On INV_ITem.ItemID = std.ITemID Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = sth.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter returncostcenter ON returncostcenter.CostCenterID = GIN.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = sth.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN SET_Department returndept ON returndept.DepartmentID = GIN.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID
INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Inv_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID --(case when std.JobID > 0 then Set_Job.AccountCode else Inv_Item.ExpenseAccountCCID end )
WHERE sth.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND ( SET_DocumentType.GroupID =@DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID is null) AND sth.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate AND sth.FiscalID =@CurrentFiscalID and isnull(std.JobID ,0) = 0
) as tab where tab.ItemID is not null group by tab.CodeDescription ,CodeCombinationID, tab.GroupID
union all
select Description,CodeCombinationID,0 as ThroughStore , sum(Amount) as PriceDifferential, 0 as Adjustment, 0 As GroupID from ( select RefrenceGLCode.CodeCombinationID,RefrenceGLCode.description, case GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else GL_TransactionDetail.Amount *-1 end as Amount from GL_TransactionDetail INNER JOIN GL_TransactionHeader ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID= GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID= GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID= GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID
INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail RefrenceGLCode on RefrenceGLCode.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.RefrenceCode
WHERE GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND ( SET_DocumentType.GroupID =@DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID is null) AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate AND GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID =@CurrentFiscalID
)as tab group by Description,CodeCombinationID
)as tab group by Description,CodeCombinationID,GroupID

data.name: Query_StoreMovementDetail
data.value:
select ItemCatalogID,ItemCatalog, SUM(OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalance,SUM(PurchasingAmount) as PurchasingAmount ,SUM(ClosingAmount) as ClosingAmount ,(MainHeading) as MainHeading,(Heading) as Heading,SUM(Value) Value from ( select * from ( Select fintab.ItemCatalogID,fintab.ItemCatalog, SUM(OpeningBalance) as OpeningBalance,SUM(PurchasingAmount) as PurchasingAmount ,SUM(ClosingAmount) as ClosingAmount ,max(MainHeading) as MainHeading,max(Heading) as Heading,SUM(Value) Value from ( select TAB.ItemCatalogID,tab.ItemCatalog,
sum(OpeningAmount) as OpeningBalance, 0 as PurchasingAmount,0 as ClosingAmount ,'' as MainHeading,'' as Heading,0 as Value FROM ( Select SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalog,INV_Item.Description,
(case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) else abs(std.TransactionQuantity)*-1 end) AS OpeningBalanceQty,
((isnull(std.AverageRate,std.TransactionCost)) * (case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) * -1 end)) + isnull(std.ValueChange,0) AS OpeningBalanceRate, SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID
,(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) end End)*std.TransactionCost as OpeningAmount
From INV_StockTransactionHeader sth INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail std ON std.StockTransactionID = sth.StockTransactionID AND std.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND std.Status = 1 Inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].TransactionImpact != 'No Impact'
and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GIn on GIN.StockTransactionID = std.SourceHeaderID and GIN.DocumentTypeID = std.SourceDocumentTypeID and GIN.CompanyID = std.CompanyID and GIN.PeriodID = std.PeriodID and GIN.FiscalID= std.FiscalID INNER JOIN INV_ITem On INV_ITem.ItemID = std.ITemID --AND INV_ITem.CompanyID = std.CompanyID Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = sth.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter returncostcenter ON returncostcenter.CostCenterID = GIN.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = sth.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN SET_Department returndept ON returndept.DepartmentID = GIN.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID
Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.CodeCombinationID Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID =std.JobID and Set_Job.CompanyID = std.CompanyID
INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1 AND SET_ItemCatalog.IsActive=1 WHERE sth.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = 1 AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.DocumentDate < (Select StartDate from SET_PeriodCustom Where FiscalId = @CurrentFiscalID ) AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID is null) and [SET_DocumentType].menuID not in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx')) and SET_ItemCatalog.GroupID is not null ) AS TAB group by tab.ItemCatalog,ItemCatalogID
UNION All ---------------------------------PURCHASEING Select SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalg, 0 as OpeningBalance ,SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost) as PurchasingAmount ,0 AS ClosingAmount ,'' as MainHeading,'' as Heading,0 as Value from INV_StockTransactionHeader INV_StockTransactionHeader
INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1 AND SET_ItemCatalog.IsActive=1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.Status=1 AND DocumentType like '%GRN%' INNER JOIN SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId=INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID --AND @AsOnDate >=SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate >= @AsOnDate
Where StatusCode=1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <=@AsOnDate AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID is null) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID =@PeriodID and SET_ItemCatalog.GroupID is not null group by SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID,SET_ItemCatalog.Description
UNION ALL ----------------Closing Of Current Fiscal----------------
select TAB.ItemCatalogID,tab.ItemCatalog, 0 as OpeningBalance, 0 as PurchasingAmount, sum(ClosingAmount) as ClosingAmount ,'' as MainHeading,'' as heading,0 as Value FROM ( Select SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalog,INV_Item.Description,
(case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) else abs(std.TransactionQuantity)*-1 end) AS OpeningBalanceQty,
((isnull(std.AverageRate,std.TransactionCost)) * (case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Positive' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) when SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact ='Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) * -1 end)) + isnull(std.ValueChange,0) AS OpeningBalanceRate, SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID
,(case SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact when 'No Impact' then 0 else case when TransactionImpact='Negative' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity)*-1 when TransactionImpact='Positive' then abs(std.TransactionQuantity) end End)*std.TransactionCost as ClosingAmount
From INV_StockTransactionHeader sth INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail std ON std.StockTransactionID = sth.StockTransactionID AND std.CompanyID = sth.CompanyID AND std.PeriodID = sth.PeriodID AND std.Status = 1 Inner join [SET_DocumentType] on [SET_DocumentType].DocumentTypeID = sth.DocumentTypeID and [SET_DocumentType].CompanyID = sth.CompanyID and [SET_DocumentType].PeriodID = sth.PeriodID and [SET_DocumentType].TransactionImpact != 'No Impact'
and [SET_DocumentType].DocumentType not like '%CPR%' and [SET_DocumentType].Status = 1 left join INV_StockTransactionHeader GIn on GIN.StockTransactionID = std.SourceHeaderID and GIN.DocumentTypeID = std.SourceDocumentTypeID and GIN.CompanyID = std.CompanyID and GIN.PeriodID = std.PeriodID and GIN.FiscalID= std.FiscalID INNER JOIN INV_ITem On INV_ITem.ItemID = std.ITemID --AND INV_ITem.CompanyID = std.CompanyID Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure On INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode = SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter ON SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = sth.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_CostCenter returncostcenter ON returncostcenter.CostCenterID = GIN.CostCenterID LEFT JOIN SET_Department ON SET_Department.DepartmentID = sth.DepartmentID LEFT JOIN SET_Department returndept ON returndept.DepartmentID = GIN.DepartmentID INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID
Inner JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.CodeCombinationID Left Join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID =std.JobID and Set_Job.CompanyID = std.CompanyID
INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1 AND SET_ItemCatalog.IsActive=1 WHERE sth.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND sth.PeriodID = 1 AND sth.Status = 1 AND sth.StatusCode = 1 AND sth.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID is null) and [SET_DocumentType].menuID not in (select MenuID from [ApplicationMenu] where MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/StockRequistion_frm.aspx')) and SET_ItemCatalog.GroupID is not null
) AS TAB group by tab.ItemCatalog,ItemCatalogID
UNION ALL
--------------------------------- CWIP Select SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID,SET_ItemCatalog.Description as ItemCatalg, 0 as OpeningBalance ,0 as PurchasingAmount ,0 as ClosingAmount ,'CWIP' as MainHeading ,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description as Heading ,(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost * TransactionQuantity *-1) as Value from INV_StockTransactionHeader INV_StockTransactionHeader

Where StatusCode=1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <=@AsOnDate AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID is null) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID =@PeriodID and Set_Job.JobCategoryID = 1 and SET_ItemCatalog.GroupID is not null UNION ALL

inner join Set_Job on Set_Job.JobID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID and Set_Job.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and Set_Job .JobCategoryID is not null
inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Set_Job.AccountCode

AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1 AND SET_ItemCatalog.IsActive=1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID INNER join ApplicationMenu on SET_DocumentType.MenuID = ApplicationMenu.MenuID and MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx','/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx')
INNER JOIN SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId=INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID --AND @AsOnDate >=SET_PeriodCustom.StartDate AND SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate >= @AsOnDate
Where StatusCode=1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <=@AsOnDate AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID is null) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID =@PeriodID and Set_Job.JobCategoryID <> 1 and SET_ItemCatalog.GroupID is not null
) as fintab
group by fintab.ItemCatalogID,fintab.ItemCatalog )as fintab --where value > 0

Where StatusCode=1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate <=@AsOnDate AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID is null) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID =@PeriodID and isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.JobID,0) = 0 and isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.IncurredOnID,0) = 0 and SET_ItemCatalog.GroupID is not null group by SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID,SET_ItemCatalog.Description

AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1 AND SET_ItemCatalog.IsActive=1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID INNER join ApplicationMenu on SET_DocumentType.MenuID = ApplicationMenu.MenuID and MenuPath in ('/Inventory/Transaction/Average/StockGIN_frm.aspx','/Inventory/Transaction/StockReturn.aspx')

data.name: Query_AgingAnalysisClosingBalanceDetail
data.value:
Select fintab.ItemID,fintab.InventoryItemStatusCode,fintab.Description,SUM(Quantity) as Quantity ,SUM(FivePlus) as FivePlus,SUM(Five) as Five,SUM(Four) as Four,SUM(Three) as Three ,SUM(Two) as Two,SUM(One) as One ,sum(isnull(ProvisionAmount_Plus5,0)) as ProvisionAmount_Plus5 ,sum(isnull(ProvisionAmount_5,0)) as ProvisionAmount_5 ,sum(isnull(ProvisionAmount_4,0)) as ProvisionAmount_4 ,sum(isnull(ProvisionAmount_3,0)) as ProvisionAmount_3 ,sum(isnull(ProvisionAmount_2,0)) as ProvisionAmount_2 ,sum(isnull(ProvisionAmount_1,0)) as ProvisionAmount_1 from ( select TAB.ItemCatalogID,ItemID,TAB.InventoryItemStatusCode,TAB.Description, sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) as Quantity, SUM(UnitPrice*TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) as FivePlus, 0 as Five, 0 as Four, 0 as Three , 0 as Two, 0 as One ,sum(ProvisionAmount_Plus5) as ProvisionAmount_Plus5 ,sum(0) as ProvisionAmount_5 ,sum(0) as ProvisionAmount_4 ,sum(0) as ProvisionAmount_3 ,sum(0) as ProvisionAmount_2 ,sum(0) as ProvisionAmount_1 FROM ( SELECT INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,INV_Item.Description, SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) AS OpeningBalanceQty,
CASE AVG(ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, 0)) WHEN 0 THEN
-- Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end )
ELSE AVG(Sal_OrderDetail.Rate) END AS UnitPrice, -- * SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) AS OpeningBalanceRate, SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID, ( select sum(case GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else GL_TransactionDetail.Amount *-1 end) as Amount from GL_TransactionHeader inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 where GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = '03-02-03-010-005' and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID --and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy, 0, DATEADD(YYYY,-5,@AsOnDate)), 0)
) as ProvisionAmount_Plus5
FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.IsActive = 1 ------------- LEFT JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] on [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].PeriodID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] and [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID=[INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and [SAL_DispatchHeader].DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status]=1
LEFT JOIN ( select SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.*, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo from SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader Inner Join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID ) as DeliveryHeaderDetail on DeliveryHeaderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceDocumentTypeID] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceCode] and DeliveryHeaderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and DeliveryHeaderDetail.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = DeliveryHeaderDetail.[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 -------------------
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Inv_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID --AND INV_Item.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 INNER JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = INV_Item.ItemTypeID -- And (INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports IS NULL OR INV_SET_Category.IsInvisibleUponStockReports = 0)
INNER JOIN SET_ItemCatalog ON SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID = INV_Item.ItemCatalogGroupID AND SET_ItemCatalog.Status=1 AND SET_ItemCatalog.IsActive=1 INNER JOIN SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId=INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID= INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location ON SET_Location.LocationID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.LocationID
LEFT JOIN SET_Location SL ON SL.LocationID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].LocationID WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.IsActive = 1 and SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact <>'No Impact' AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy, 0, DATEADD(YYYY,-5,@AsOnDate)), 0)
AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND (isnull(SL.LocationID,SET_Location.LocationID) = @LocationID OR @LocationID is null) --AND (SET_DocumentType.GroupID = @DocumentGroupID OR @DocumentGroupID is null) GROUP BY [SAL_DispatchHeader].[IsCancelled], SAL_OrderDetail.Orderid, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID, INV_Item.ItemID, INV_Item.Description, SET_Location.LocationName, SL.LocationName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.TransactionImpact, INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID, INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode , INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode, INV_Item.UnitVolume, SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID, INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,INV_Item.UnitWeight, Cast(INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate as date) ,INV_StockTransactionDetail.ImpactID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ) AS TAB group by TAB.ItemCatalogID,ItemID,TAB.InventoryItemStatusCode,TAB.Description
UNION ALL ----------------5----------------
select TAB.ItemCatalogID,ItemID,TAB.InventoryItemStatusCode,TAB.Description ,sum(TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) as Quantity, 0 as FivePlus, SUM(UnitPrice*TAB.OpeningBalanceQty) as Five, 0 as Four, 0 as Three ,0 as Two, 0 as One ,sum(0) as ProvisionAmount_Plus5 ,sum(ProvisionAmount_5) as ProvisionAmount_5 ,sum(0) as ProvisionAmount_4 ,sum(0) as ProvisionAmount_3 ,sum(0) as ProvisionAmount_2 ,sum(0) as ProvisionAmount_1 FROM (
SELECT INV_Item.ItemID,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode,INV_Item.Description, SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) AS OpeningBalanceQty,
CASE AVG(ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate, 0)) WHEN 0 THEN
-- Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) (case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange IS null then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) when SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))=0 then Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) /1 else Avg(Isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost,0)) + Avg(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.ValueChange,0)) / SUM(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,1)) end )
ELSE AVG(Sal_OrderDetail.Rate) END AS UnitPrice, -- * SUM(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) AS OpeningBalanceRate, SET_ItemCatalog.ItemCatalogID ,( select sum(case GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else GL_TransactionDetail.Amount *-1 end) as Amount from GL_TransactionHeader inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 where GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = '03-02-03-010-005' and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID --and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate -- AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy, 0, DATEADD(YYYY,-5,@AsOnDate)), 0) AND (convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) >= DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy, 0, DATEADD(YYYY,-5,@AsOnDate)), 0) AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) <= DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy, 0, DATEADD(YYYY,-5,@AsOnDate)) + 1, -1) )
) as ProvisionAmount_5

(Select SUM(FivePlus+Five+Four+Three+Two+One) from Cte wte) as Closing, CASE WHEN Amount !=0 then (Amount/(Select SUM(FivePlus+Five+Four+Three+Two+One) from Cte wte) ) *100 else 0 end as percentage, Amount, CASE WHEN indicatorname='FivePlus' then Pre_FivePlus WHEN indicatorname='Five' then Pre_Five WHEN indicatorname='Four' then Pre_Four WHEN indicatorname='Three' then Pre_Three WHEN indicatorname='Two' then Pre_Two WHEN indicatorname='One' then Pre_One else '' end PreviousAmount, (Select SUM(Pre_FivePlus+Pre_Five+Pre_Four+Pre_Three+Pre_Two+Pre_One) from Cte wte) as PreClosing, CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN indicatorname='FivePlus' then Pre_FivePlus WHEN indicatorname='Five' then Pre_Five WHEN indicatorname='Four' then Pre_Four WHEN indicatorname='Three' then Pre_Three WHEN indicatorname='Two' then Pre_Two WHEN indicatorname='One' then Pre_One else '' end) !=0 then ( (CASE WHEN indicatorname='FivePlus' then Pre_FivePlus WHEN indicatorname='Five' then Pre_Five WHEN indicatorname='Four' then Pre_Four WHEN indicatorname='Three' then Pre_Three WHEN indicatorname='Two' then Pre_Two WHEN indicatorname='One' then Pre_One else '' end)/(Select SUM(Pre_FivePlus+Pre_Five+Pre_Four+Pre_Three+Pre_Two+Pre_One) from Cte wte) ) *100 else 0 end as Prepercentage ,( select sum(case GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else GL_TransactionDetail.Amount *-1 end) as Amount from GL_TransactionHeader inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 where GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = '03-02-03-010-005' and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @AsOnDate
) as ProvisionAmount ,( select sum(case GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else GL_TransactionDetail.Amount *-1 end) as Amount from GL_TransactionHeader inner join GL_TransactionDetail on GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID and GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 where GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = '03-02-03-010-005' and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @PreviousDate
) as PreviousProvisionAmount from cte unpivot ( Amount
for indicatorname in (FivePlus,Five,Four,Three,Two,One)
) unpiv;

data.name: Query_SalesPromotionAndExpenceDetail
data.value:
--Declare @AsOnDate datetime = '2021-02-23 00:00:00:000'
----------from Sale Order
SELECT SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate, sum(ABS(isnull(Sal_OrderDetail.Quantity,0))) as Quantity,sum(isnull(Sal_OrderDetail.GrossAmount,0)) as Amount, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, SAL_OrderHeader.Remarks FROM SAL_OrderHeader
inner join Sal_OrderDetail on Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID= SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID= SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID and Sal_OrderDetail.Status=1
Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= SAL_OrderHeader.SaleContractTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID= SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID= SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status=1
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = SAL_OrderHeader.CostCenterID
INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SET_Company.CompanyId
INNER JOIN SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.BusinessId = SET_Business.BusinessId AND SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID
WHERE SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = 1 AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate <= @AsOnDate and SET_CostCenter.HeadingCostCenterName like '%promotion%' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%sale%order%sugar'
group by SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,SAL_OrderHeader.CostCenterID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName,SAL_OrderHeader.Remarks

data.name: Query_SalesPromotionAndExpenceSummary
data.value:
--declare @DocumentTypeID int = null --Declare @AsOnDate datetime = '2021-02-23 00:00:00:000'
----------from Sale Order
select finalTab.CostCenterID,finalTab.CostCenterName,SUM(finalTab.QuantityUnit1) as QuantityUnit1 ,SUM(finalTab.QuantityUnit2) as QuantityUnit2,SUM(finalTab.AmountUnit1) as AmountUnit1,SUM(finalTab.AmountUnit2) as AmountUnit2 from ( select tab.CostCenterID,tab.CostCenterName ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - I' then tab.Quantity else 0 end) as QuantityUnit1 ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - II' then tab.Quantity else 0 end) as QuantityUnit2 ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - I' then tab.Amount else 0 end) as AmountUnit1 ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - II' then tab.Amount else 0 end) as AmountUnit2 from ( SELECT SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, SAL_OrderHeader.CostCenterID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, sum(ABS(isnull(Sal_OrderDetail.Quantity,0))) as Quantity, sum(isnull(Sal_OrderDetail.GrossAmount,0)) as Amount
FROM SAL_OrderHeader
inner join Sal_OrderDetail on Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID AND Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID= SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID= SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID and Sal_OrderDetail.Status=1
Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= SAL_OrderHeader.SaleContractTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID= SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID= SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status=1
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = SAL_OrderHeader.CostCenterID
INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SET_Company.CompanyId
INNER JOIN SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.BusinessId = SET_Business.BusinessId AND SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID
WHERE SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = 1 AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate <= @AsOnDate and SET_CostCenter.HeadingCostCenterName like '%promotion%' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%sale%order%sugar' group by SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,SAL_OrderHeader.CostCenterID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName
)tab )finalTab
group by finalTab.CostCenterID,finalTab.CostCenterName
--------From dispatch select SUM(finalTab.QuantityUnit1) as QuantityUnit1 ,SUM(finalTab.QuantityUnit2) as QuantityUnit2,SUM(finalTab.AmountUnit1) as AmountUnit1,SUM(finalTab.AmountUnit2) as AmountUnit2 from ( select (case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - I' then tab.Quantity else 0 end) as QuantityUnit1 ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - II' then tab.Quantity else 0 end) as QuantityUnit2 ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - I' then tab.Amount else 0 end) as AmountUnit1 ,(case when tab.OperatingUnitName = 'Unit - II' then tab.Amount else 0 end) as AmountUnit2 from ( SELECT SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName, --SAL_DispatchHeader.CostCentreID, SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, sum(ABS(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity,0))) as Quantity, sum(isnull(INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount,0)) as Amount
FROM SAL_DispatchHeader inner JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1
LEFT JOIN GL_TransactionHeader ON GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID= SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID= SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID= SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID and SET_DocumentType.Status=1
left JOIN SET_City ON SET_City.CityID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CityID AND SET_City.Status = 1
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader on SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceCode and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DocumentTypeID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceDocumentTypeID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID= [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID= [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.Status=1
inner join SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail on SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID= [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID= [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID and SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status=1
inner join Sal_OrderDetail on Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID and Sal_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID= SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID and Sal_OrderDetail.Status=1
inner join Sal_OrderHeader on Sal_OrderHeader.OrderID = Sal_OrderDetail.OrderID and Sal_OrderHeader.CompanyID = Sal_OrderDetail.CompanyID and Sal_OrderHeader.PeriodID = Sal_OrderDetail.PeriodID and Sal_OrderHeader.Status=1
inner join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = Sal_OrderHeader.CostCenterID
INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = SET_Company.CompanyId
INNER JOIN SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.BusinessId = SET_Business.BusinessId AND SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
inner join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID
WHERE SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = 1 AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate <= @AsOnDate and SET_CostCenter.HeadingCostCenterName like '%promotion%' and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' group by SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName
)tab )finalTab

TransactionType, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, '' as DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName As CostCenter, 0 As SerialNo,'' as DetailNarration ,SET_Department.DepartmentName FROM AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID where [AR_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AR_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [AR_InvoiceHeader].invoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND [AR_InvoiceHeader].statusCode <> 1 And [AR_InvoiceHeader].status = 1 and ([AR_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType = @DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) union all -- Freight Amount select AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID,[AR_InvoiceHeader].invoicetype,[AR_InvoiceHeader].invoicenumber ,AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmountCCID as AccountCodes ,ltrim(rtrim(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description)) as CodeDescription ,AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount as AccountDtlAmount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,AR_InvoiceHeader.description as Narration , (Case ( Select COUNT(SerialNo) as count from SET_Parameter where FieldName='VoucherPrint' and IsVisible=1) when 1 then (Case isnull(Set_DocumentType.Description,'') when '' then convert(varchar(24),AR_InvoiceHeader.invoicenumber) else Set_DocumentType.Description+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate) end ) else convert(varchar(24),AR_InvoiceHeader.invoicenumber) end )as VoucherNumber ,Set_DocumentType.Description as DocDescription,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate from AR_InvoiceHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmountCCID where [AR_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AR_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [AR_InvoiceHeader].invoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND [AR_InvoiceHeader].statusCode <> 1 And [AR_InvoiceHeader].status = 1 and isnull(FreightAmountCCID,'') <> '' and ([AR_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType = @DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) union all
-- Other Amount select AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID,[AR_InvoiceHeader].invoicetype,[AR_InvoiceHeader].invoicenumber ,AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherCCID as AccountCodes ,ltrim(rtrim(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description)) as CodeDescription ,AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherAmount * -1 as AccountDtlAmount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,AR_InvoiceHeader.description as Narration , (Case ( Select COUNT(SerialNo) as count from SET_Parameter where FieldName='VoucherPrint' and IsVisible=1) when 1 then (Case isnull(Set_DocumentType.Description,'') when '' then convert(varchar(24),AR_InvoiceHeader.invoicenumber) else Set_DocumentType.Description+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate) end ) else convert(varchar(24),AR_InvoiceHeader.invoicenumber) end )as VoucherNumber ,Set_DocumentType.Description as DocDescription,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate from AR_InvoiceHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_InvoiceHeader.OtherCCID where [AR_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AR_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [AR_InvoiceHeader].invoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND [AR_InvoiceHeader].statusCode <> 1 And [AR_InvoiceHeader].status = 1 and isnull(OtherCCID,'') <> '' and ([AR_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType = @DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) union all -- INvoice TAX select AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID,[AR_InvoiceHeader].invoicetype,[AR_InvoiceHeader].invoicenumber ,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID as AccountCodes ,ltrim(rtrim(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description)) as CodeDescription ,Ar_invoiceDetail.TaxAmountOnNet as AccountDtlAmount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,AR_InvoiceHeader.description as Narration , (Case ( Select COUNT(SerialNo) as count from SET_Parameter where FieldName='VoucherPrint' and IsVisible=1) when 1 then (Case isnull(Set_DocumentType.Description,'') when '' then convert(varchar(24),AR_InvoiceHeader.invoicenumber) else Set_DocumentType.Description+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),AR_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate) end ) else convert(varchar(24),AR_InvoiceHeader.invoicenumber) end )as VoucherNumber ,Set_DocumentType.Description as DocDescription,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate from AR_InvoiceHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN Ar_invoiceDetail on Ar_invoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = Ar_invoiceDetail.ItemID
left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = INV_Item.PurchasingTaxCCID
where [AR_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [AR_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [AR_InvoiceHeader].invoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND [AR_InvoiceHeader].statusCode <> 1 And [AR_InvoiceHeader].status = 1 and ([AR_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType = @DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null) ) as TAB where AccountCodes is not null ) as PurchaseInvoiceTAB
union all ------------------------- GL Voucher (Sales Invoice) --------------------------------------- Select * from ( select AccountCodes as CodeCombinationID,[invoicenumber] as [DocumentNo], DocumentDate as DocumentDate, Narration, ISNULL((CASE WHEN Amount > 0 THEN Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DebitAmount, ISNULL((CASE WHEN Amount < 0 THEN abs(Amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CreditAmount, ISNULL((CASE WHEN Amount > 0 THEN 'Debit' ELSE 'Credit' END), 0) AS TransactionType , CodeDescription as Description, DocumentType ,'' As CostCenter, 0 As SerialNo ,1 as InProcessDoc from (
select SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].[invoicenumber] ,AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID as AccountCodes ,ltrim(rtrim(SuppCC.Description)) as CodeDescription ,case Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType when 'Credit' then isnull(Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount, 0) *-1 when 'Debit' then isnull(Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount, 0) else 0 end as Amount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration , (Case ( Select COUNT(SerialNo) as count from SET_Parameter where FieldName='VoucherPrint' and IsVisible=1) when 1 then (Case isnull(Set_DocumentType.Description,'') when '' then convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicenumber) else Set_DocumentType.Description+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate) end ) else convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicenumber) end ) as VoucherNumber ,Set_DocumentType.Description as DocDescription,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate from SAL_InvoiceHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID inner join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail on Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status = 1 left join AR_SET_Customer MultiCustomer on MultiCustomer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = MultiCustomer.CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = MultiCustomer.PeriodID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail as SuppCC on SuppCC.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID AND SuppCC.ChartofAccountID = isnull(AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_ChartofAccountID,1)
where [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].invoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].statusCode <> 1 And [SAL_InvoiceHeader].status = 1 and ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType = @DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null)
union all select distinct SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].invoicetype,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].invoicenumber ,Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID as AccountCodes ,ltrim(rtrim(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description)) as CodeDescription ,case Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then abs(Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.amount) else Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.amount *-1 end as AccountDtlAmount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Narration , (Case ( Select COUNT(SerialNo) as count from SET_Parameter where FieldName='VoucherPrint' and IsVisible=1) when 1 then (Case isnull(Set_DocumentType.Description,'') when '' then convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicenumber) else Set_DocumentType.Description+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate) end ) else convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicenumber) end )as VoucherNumber ,Set_DocumentType.Description as DocDescription,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate from SAL_InvoiceHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID left join Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail on Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1 left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CodeCombinationID where [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].invoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].statusCode <> 1 And [SAL_InvoiceHeader].status = 1 and ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType = @DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null)
union all --GST TAX select distinct SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].invoicetype,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].invoicenumber ,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID as AccountCodes ,ltrim(rtrim(GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description)) as CodeDescription , (Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.Amount * GST /100) *-1 as AccountDtlAmount ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,'GST TAX' as Narration , (Case ( Select COUNT(SerialNo) as count from SET_Parameter where FieldName='VoucherPrint' and IsVisible=1) when 1 then (Case isnull(Set_DocumentType.Description,'') when '' then convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicenumber) else Set_DocumentType.Description+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceDate) end ) else convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicenumber) end )as VoucherNumber ,Set_DocumentType.Description as DocDescription,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate from SAL_InvoiceHeader inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID inner join Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail on Fabrics_SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_invoiceHEader.InvoiceID left join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = (select top 1 SaleInvoiceGSTCode from Fabrics_InvoiceParameters )
where [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID and [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].invoiceDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND [SAL_InvoiceHeader].statusCode <> 1 And [SAL_InvoiceHeader].status = 1 and ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceType = @DocumentTypeID or @DocumentTypeID is null)
) as TAB where AccountCodes is not null ) as SalesInvoiceTAB
) t

data.name: Query_GetBalanceSheetReport
data.value:
SELECT Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, (CASE WHEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) > 0 THEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningDebit, (CASE WHEN (SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) < 0 THEN ABS(SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit)) ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningCredit, SUM(Debit) AS Debit, SUM(Credit) AS Credit, (CASE WHEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) > 0 THEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) ELSE 0 END) AS ClosingDebit, (CASE WHEN ((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) < 0 THEN ABS((SUM(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (SUM(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit))) ELSE 0 END) AS ClosingCredit, Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag FROM ( SELECT GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, 0 AS Debit, 0 AS Credit FROM GL_CodeCombinationDetail WHERE --GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartofAccountID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1
UNION ALL SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningDebit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningCredit, 0 As Debit, 0 As Credit FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartofAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
UNION ALL SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Debit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Credit FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartofAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate >= @FromDate AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate <= @ToDate AND GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 ) Tab_COA_Tran1 INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON --Tab_COA_Tran1.CompanyID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID AND Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID AND Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID WHERE GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1 and GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID not in (select AccountTypeID from SET_AccountType where AccountTypeName in ('Revenue','Expenses','Adjustments')) GROUP BY Tab_COA_Tran1.CompanyID, Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag
