data.name: Query_ExpansesOfYears
data.value: select Description,CodeDescription,Sum(Amount) as Amount ,year from ( select GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description As CodeDescription,'Office Rent and Rennovation Expenses' as Description,case when TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount * -1 else GL_TransactionDetail.Amount end as Amount ,year(GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate ) as year from GL_TransactionDetail inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionDetail.FiscalID inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID where GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description = 'REPAIR & MAINTENANCE' and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate between @fromDate and @ToDate )as tab group by CodeDescription,Description,year

data.name: Query_FinancialDetailMonthWise
data.value:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED SELECT (select max(financialid)+1 from set_financialheader) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description ASC) as FinancialID , GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description FinancialName, convert(bit,0) NewPage, 'D' as ElementType, 'L' as Alignment, convert(bit,0) Bold , --ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description ASC) as ElementSequence , @FinancialHeaderID as ElementSequence, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description ElementName, '' as NoteNo, CASE WHEN GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID in (8,11,10) then convert(bit,0) else convert(bit,1) end ExpectedResultInDb, convert(bit,0) DataIn, convert(bit,0) FixedInput, null as Amount, convert(bit,0) DataToBeCollected, null as Formula, '000' FinancialCode, 0 as Segment, Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID as COACodeFrom , Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID as COACodeTo, Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID ,'' AS Action, 2 as OrderBy , Month ,Months ,yearname
FROM ( SELECT GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, 0 AS Debit, 0 AS Credit ,CONVERT(CHAR(4), @FromDate, 100) as Month ,Month(@FromDate) as Months , CONVERT(CHAR(4), @FromDate, 120) yearname FROM GL_CodeCombinationDetail WHERE GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartofAccountID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningDebit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningCredit, 0 As Debit, 0 As Credit
,CONVERT(CHAR(4), @FromDate, 100) as Month ,Month(@FromDate) as Months , CONVERT(CHAR(4), @FromDate, 120) yearname
FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID {1} INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = @ChartofAccountID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate AND GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1

INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and INV_StockTransactionheader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionheader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID inner join AR_InvoiceDetail invDtl on invDtl.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID and invDtl.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and invDtl.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID and invDtl.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID and invDtl.Status = 1 where INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 and invDtl.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and invDtl.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and invDtl.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS GRN_NO ,STUFF(( Select distinct ', ' + convert(varchar(10), AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.DocumentNumber) from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader left join AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID=AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 Where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS PO_NO, 0 as InvoiceQuantity
FROM INV_StockTransactionHeader INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
----------------------
inner JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1
----------------------
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
{9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) And (AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = @BusinessPartnerID Or @BusinessPartnerID is null) and INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID is not null and INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID is not null {0} {5} {6} {11} {12}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode, FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO, InvoiceQuantity
UNION ALL ----Sales Invoice Return SELECT distinct SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate AS DocumentDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, ISNULL(SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo, 0) as DocumentNo, 0 as Debit , SUM(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount) as Credit, '' AS InstrumentNo, GL_TransactionHeader.Narration AS Comments, GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID as CodeCombinationID , GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) as InvoiceQuantity,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO ,'' as VehicleNo FROM SET_DocumentType Inner join SAL_ReverseHeader on SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SET_DocumentType.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseHeader.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
inner join SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID and SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID =SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID
left join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = SAL_ReverseHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Local Sale Debtor - Sugar' left join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID WHERE SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND convert(date,SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and SAL_ReverseHeader.StatusCode = 1
{0} {6} {9} {12} GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,AR_SET_Customer.ContactNumber , AR_SET_Customer.ContactPerson , AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1,SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate,SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount ,SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo ,SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID ,GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description,GL_TransactionHeader.Narration,SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced )as tab Left Join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.FK_CustomerID = tab.CustomerID AND HRMS_Set_Employee.CompanyID in @CompanyID {7} {8} {10}

Select * from (
select DocumentDate,tab.CreateDate,tab.CompanyID,DocumentType,DocumentTypeID ,CostCenterName ,tab.CustomerID ,case when HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode is null then tab.CustomerName else tab.CustomerName + ' (' + HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode + ')' end as CustomerName ,DocumentNo ,debit ,credit ,InstrumentNo ,Comments, TaxPercentage, CodeCombinationID ,CodeDescription ,InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO ,(Select OperatingUnitName from SET_OperatingUnit where OperatingUnitId = tab.CompanyID) as UnitName from ( select @FromDate AS DocumentDate,@FromDate AS CreateDate,CompanyID, 'Opening' AS DocumentType,0 AS DocumentTypeID,'' as CostCenterName, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.CustomerName,null as DocumentNo,
Abs(Sum(Debit)) debit,
Sum(credit) as credit,'' as InstrumentNo,'' as Comments, '' as TaxPercentage, CodeCombinationID CodeCombinationID,CodeDescription ,'' as InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
from ( SELECT 'Opening' as DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Comments, '' as TaxPercentage, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO FROM ( Select distinct OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, Sum(OpeningTAB.Debit) As Debit, --------------- Sale Inovice Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalID is null and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.IsReversed,0) = 0 AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate {9}--{9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} {6} {11} {12} ) As OpeningTAB Group By OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID , OpeningTAB.CodeDescription, OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber

FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, '' as TaxPercentage, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber From And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate {9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} {6} {11} {12} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
UNION ALL ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- OPENING Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments,'' as TaxPercentage, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, '' as CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber From Sal_InvoiceHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID
Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode
inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode Where Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) < @FromDate {9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' {0} {5} {6} {12}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber

Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode

Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(AR_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) < @FromDate {9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' {0} {5} {6} {12}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber

INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON DirectLcExpense_Header.ClearingAgentID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND DirectLcExpense_Header.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = DirectLcExpense_Header.CustomClearingID and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = DirectLcExpense_Header.CompanyID and DirectLcExpense_Header.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1
INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = DirectLcExpense_Header.ClearingAgentID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = DirectLcExpense_Header.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Vendor'
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID WHERE DirectLcExpense_Header.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND DirectLcExpense_Header.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND convert(date,DirectLcExpense_Header.Createdate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate

{0} {5} {6} {11} {12} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode, FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO

GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit, GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,'' AS InstrumentNo ,AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumber ,STUFF(( select And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 Where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS PO_NO

INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
----------------------
inner JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.InvoiceHeaderID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1
----------------------
WHERE INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND convert(date,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate

{0} {5} {6} {11} {12}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType,FinTab.DocumentTypeID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode, FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
UNION ALL ----Sales Invoice Return SELECT distinct SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate AS DocumentDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate, SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, ISNULL(SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo, 0) as DocumentNo, 0 as Debit , SUM(SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedAmount) as Credit, '' AS InstrumentNo, GL_TransactionHeader.Narration AS Comments,'' as TaxPercentage, GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID as CodeCombinationID , GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO FROM SET_DocumentType Inner join SAL_ReverseHeader on SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID= SET_DocumentType.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID and SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseHeader.Status = 1 and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1

inner join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
inner join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID =SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID

data.name: Query_CustomerLedgerReport
data.value:
select DocumentDate,tab.CreateDate,tab.CompanyID,DocumentType,DocumentTypeID ,CostCenterName ,tab.CustomerID ,case when HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode is null then tab.CustomerName else tab.CustomerName + ' (' + HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode + ')' end as CustomerName ,DocumentNo ,debit ,credit ,InstrumentNo ,Comments ,CodeCombinationID ,CodeDescription ,InvoiceNumber,SalesQuantity,GRN_NO,PO_NO ,(Select OperatingUnitName from SET_OperatingUnit where OperatingUnitId = tab.CompanyID) as UnitName from ( select @FromDate AS DocumentDate,@FromDate AS CreateDate,CompanyID, 'Opening' AS DocumentType,0 AS DocumentTypeID,'' as CostCenterName, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.CustomerName,null as DocumentNo,
Abs(Sum(Debit)) debit,
Sum(credit) as credit,'' as InstrumentNo,'' as Comments, CodeCombinationID CodeCombinationID,CodeDescription ,'' as InvoiceNumber,0 as SalesQuantity,GRN_NO,PO_NO
from ( SELECT 'Opening' as DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Comments, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber, 0 as SalesQuantity,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO FROM ( Select distinct OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, Sum(OpeningTAB.Debit) As Debit, Sum(OpeningTAB.Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description As Comments, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID ,OpeningTAB.CodeDescription,OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber, OpeningTAB.SalesQuantity From ( --------------- Sale Inovice Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber, 0 as SalesQuantity From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalID is null and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.IsReversed,0) = 0 AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate {9}--{9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} {6} {11} {12} ) As OpeningTAB Group By OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID , OpeningTAB.CodeDescription, OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber,OpeningTAB.SalesQuantity
UNION ALL ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber, FinTab.SalesQuantity From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber, 0 as SalesQuantity From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate {9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} {6} {11} {12} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,FinTab.SalesQuantity
UNION ALL ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- OPENING Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber,FinTab.SalesQuantity From ( Select distinct Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, '' as CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber,0 as SalesQuantity From Sal_InvoiceHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID
Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode

AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status=1 Where AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID=AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID=AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.Status=1
FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS PO_NO

data.name: Query_BusinessPartnerGLDetailWithOrWithOutTaxNew
data.value:
Select * from (
select DocumentDate,tab.CreateDate,tab.CompanyID,DocumentType,DocumentTypeID ,CostCenterName ,tab.CustomerID ,case when HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode is null then tab.CustomerName else tab.CustomerName + ' (' + HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode + ')' end as CustomerName ,DocumentNo ,debit ,credit ,InstrumentNo ,Comments, TaxPercentage, CodeCombinationID ,CodeDescription ,InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO ,(Select OperatingUnitName from SET_OperatingUnit where OperatingUnitId = tab.CompanyID) as UnitName from ( select @FromDate AS DocumentDate,@FromDate AS CreateDate,CompanyID, 'Opening' AS DocumentType,0 AS DocumentTypeID,'' as CostCenterName, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.CustomerName,null as DocumentNo,
Abs(Sum(Debit)) debit,
Sum(credit) as credit,'' as InstrumentNo,'' as Comments, '' as TaxPercentage, CodeCombinationID CodeCombinationID,CodeDescription ,'' as InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
from ( SELECT 'Opening' as DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Comments, '' as TaxPercentage, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO FROM ( Select distinct OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, Sum(OpeningTAB.Debit) As Debit, Sum(OpeningTAB.Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description As Comments, '' as TaxPercentage, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID ,OpeningTAB.CodeDescription,OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber From ( Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = ) FinalTab

data.name: Query_FinancialReport_PF
data.value:
Select ID, Heading,Description, 0 OpeningCredit, 0 OpeningDebit, 0 ClosingCredit,0 ClosingDebit,Cast(YEAR(@FromDate) as varchar) FromYear ,Cast(YEAR(@ToDate) as varchar) ToYear From GL_CodeCombination_PF Where isActive = 0
Union All
Select ID, Heading,Description, SUM(OpeningCredit) OpeningCredit, Sum(OpeningDebit)OpeningDebit, SUM(ClosingCredit) ClosingCredit,Sum(ClosingDebit)ClosingDebit ,Cast(YEAR(@FromDate) as varchar) FromYear ,Cast(YEAR(@ToDate) as varchar) ToYear
from ( SELECT GL_CodeCombination_PF.ID, GL_CodeCombination_PF.Heading, GL_CodeCombination_PF.Description as Description,
GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, case GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag when 1 then case when (SUM(OpeningCredit) > SUM(OpeningDebit) and SUM(OpeningCredit) <> SUM(OpeningDebit)) then SUM(OpeningCredit) - SUM(OpeningDebit) else 0 end else SUM(OpeningCredit) end as OpeningCredit,
case GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag when 1 then case when (SUM(OpeningCredit) > SUM(OpeningDebit) and SUM(OpeningCredit) <> SUM(OpeningDebit)) then 0 else case when (SUM(OpeningCredit) < SUM(OpeningDebit) and SUM(OpeningCredit) <> SUM(OpeningDebit)) then SUM(OpeningDebit) - SUM(OpeningCredit) else 0 end end else SUM(OpeningDebit) end as OpeningDebit,
case GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag when 1 then case when ((sum(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit)) > (sum(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) and (sum(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit)) <> (sum(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit))) then 0 else case when ((sum(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit)) < (sum(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) and (sum(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit)) <> (sum(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit))) then (sum(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) - (sum(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit)) else 0 end end else (sum(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) end as ClosingDebit, case GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag when 1 then case when ((sum(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit)) > (sum(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) and (sum(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit)) <> (sum(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit))) then (sum(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit)) - (sum(OpeningDebit) + SUM(Debit)) else 0 end else sum(OpeningCredit) + SUM(Credit) end ClosingCredit FROM ( --SELECT GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, -- 0 As OpeningCredit, 0 AS Debit, 0 AS Credit --FROM GL_CodeCombinationDetail --WHERE GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 -- AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1
--UNION ALL
SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningDebit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS OpeningCredit, 0 As Debit, 0 As Credit FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID in (1) AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND convert(date, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate AND GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 And (GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID = Null Or Null is null) And (GL_TransactionDetail.DepartmentID = Null Or Null is null) AND Set_DocumentType.GroupID in (1)
UNION ALL
SELECT GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID, GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, 0 As OpeningDebit, 0 As OpeningCredit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Debit, (CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Credit FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = SET_DocumentType.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID
WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID in (1) AND GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) between @FromDate AND @ToDate AND GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 And (GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID = Null Or Null is null) And (GL_TransactionDetail.DepartmentID = Null Or Null is null ) AND Set_DocumentType.GroupID in (1)
) Tab_COA_Tran1 inner join SET_OperatingUnit on SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = Tab_COA_Tran1.CompanyID INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID AND Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID
Inner join GL_CodeCombination_PF on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between GL_CodeCombination_PF.CodeCombinationID_From AND GL_CodeCombination_PF.CodeCombinationID_To And GL_CodeCombination_PF.isActive = 1
where GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive = 1 AND (GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag = Null OR Null IS NULL)
--GL_CodeCombination_PF.CodeCombinationID_From AND GL_CodeCombination_PF.CodeCombinationID_To GROUP BY GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Status,GL_CodeCombinationDetail.IsActive,Tab_COA_Tran1.CompanyID, Tab_COA_Tran1.ChartOfAccountID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.HeadAccountCode, Tab_COA_Tran1.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.SummaryFlag, GL_CodeCombination_PF.Description,GL_CodeCombination_PF.Heading, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.AccountTypeID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.DetailPostingAllowedFlag,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName,SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId,GL_CodeCombination_PF.ID )FinTab group By ID, Heading,Description Order by ID

data.name: Query_GetAmountsForDashBoard
data.value:
Select ABS(AMount)Amount,AccountTypeName from (
Select SUM(Amount)Amount,AccountTypeName from ( Select case when TransactionType = 'Credit' then Amount * -1 else Amount end Amount
,TransactionType,AccountTypeName,GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID,Description from GL_TransactionDetail inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionDetail.FiscalID inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID inner join SET_AccountType on SET_AccountType.AccountTypeID= GL_CodeCOmbinationDetail.AccountTypeID
where GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 and AccountTypeName = 'Revenue' and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0} ) as tab group by AccountTypeName union all Select SUM(Amount)Amount,AccountTypeName from ( Select case when TransactionType = 'Credit' then Amount * -1 else Amount end Amount
,TransactionType,AccountTypeName,GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID,Description from GL_TransactionDetail inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionDetail.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID inner join SET_AccountType on SET_AccountType.AccountTypeID= GL_CodeCOmbinationDetail.AccountTypeID
where GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 and AccountTypeName = 'Expenses' and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0} ) as tab group by AccountTypeName union all
Select SUM(Amount)Amount,AccountTypeName from ( Select case when TransactionType = 'Credit' then Amount * -1 else Amount end Amount
,TransactionType,AccountTypeName,GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID,Description from GL_TransactionDetail inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionDetail.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID inner join SET_AccountType on SET_AccountType.AccountTypeID= GL_CodeCOmbinationDetail.AccountTypeID
where GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 and AccountTypeName = 'Assets' and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0} ) as tab group by AccountTypeName
union all Select SUM(Amount)Amount,AccountTypeName from ( Select case when TransactionType = 'Credit' then Amount * -1 else Amount end Amount
,TransactionType,AccountTypeName,GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID,Description from GL_TransactionDetail inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID inner join SET_AccountType on SET_AccountType.AccountTypeID= GL_CodeCOmbinationDetail.AccountTypeID
where GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 and AccountTypeName = 'Liability' and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID
{0}
) as tab group by AccountTypeName union all Select SUM(Amount)Amount,AccountTypeName from ( Select case when TransactionType = 'Credit' then Amount * -1 else Amount end Amount
,TransactionType,AccountTypeName,GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID,Description from GL_TransactionDetail inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionDetail.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner join GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID inner join SET_AccountType on SET_AccountType.AccountTypeID= GL_CodeCOmbinationDetail.AccountTypeID
where GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 and GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 and AccountTypeName = 'Capital/ Proprietership' and GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID {0}
) as tab group by AccountTypeName ) as ftab

data.name: Query_GL_LogReport_data

Select GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description, GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate, GL_TransactionHeader.CreatedByValue, sum((case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else 0 end)) as Credit, sum((case when GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount else 0 end)) as Debit, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, GL_TransactionHeader.UpdateDate, GL_TransactionHeader.UpdatedByValue, GL_TransactionHeader.ApprovedBy, aspnet_Users.UserName as ApprovedByName, GL_TransactionDetail.Narration, GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode ,Set_OPeratingUnit.OperatingUnitName from GL_TransactionDetail
INNER JOIN GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID And GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID --AND GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID=GL_TransactionDetail.FiscalID
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID
INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail on GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
INNER JOIN SET_Company on SET_Company.CompanyId = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID INNER JOIN Set_OPeratingUnit on Set_OPeratingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
LEFT JOIN aspnet_Users ON aspnet_Users.UserId = GL_TransactionHeader.ApprovedBy WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID in ({CompanyIDs}) AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID {0} {1}

'Debit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END AS DebitAmount, CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' THEN GL_TransactionDetail.Amount ELSE 0 END AS CreditAmount, GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status = 1 INNER JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON --GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.ChartOfAccountID = GL_TransactionDetail.ChartOfAccountID AND GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID inner join SET_costcenter on GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID = SET_costcenter.CostCenterID WHERE GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID IN @CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And GL_TransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and
